_comment: AB-530 cutover plan. Read by tools/retirement/cutover.py (make cutover). Every step is executed by a named owner in production, never from this repository; the tool only validates the plan and computes the go/no-go and hypercare decisions. See docs/pas/cutover-runbook.md.
component: PAS on COBOL/CICS/DB2 (CICS PNEW, PRWL, PEND, PQRY, PUWR; CA-7 PAS0050, PAS0100, PAS0200; DB2 ACMEINS)
replacement: pas-policy-service and pas-batch on PostgreSQL ACMEINS

owners.role: Cutover lead (release manager, owns routing state and the go/no-go call)
Mainframe team (CICS, CA-7, DB2 freeze and unfreeze)
DBA (final sync, reconciliation, sequence alignment, reverse sync)
Platform SRE (deployments, gateway routes, scheduler, alerts)

prerequisites.description: Parallel run: one clean billing cycle, rollback window agreed, production-sized rollback rehearsal, AB-529 sign-offs
Claims and Actuarial extracts: parallel runs passed and consumers signed off (AB-527)
Policy inquiry consumers moved off java-facade and onto the IdP (AB-524 G1, G2, G4)
Event path and bridge verified with FileNet and the underwriting work queue; Broker Portal on the inquiry API (AB-528 G1, G2, G3)

freeze_window.description: Saturday night after the PAS0050 01:00 premium run and before Monday 06:00 channel opening, outside month end (PAS0200 runs on the 1st) and outside the Claims cut-off. No PAS writes on any path during the window: CICS transactions PNEW, PRWL, PEND, PUWR disabled, CA-7 PAS0050/PAS0100/PAS0200 held, API write routes return 503.

capabilities.name: Premium batch
capabilities.switch: CA-7: HOLD PAS0050; platform scheduler: enable premiumRecalculation
capabilities.rollback: suspend the platform job, RELEASE PAS0050

capabilities.name: Policy inquiry
capabilities.rollback: gateway route back to java-facade; PQRY stays enabled until decommission

capabilities.name: New business
capabilities.switch: channel calls the API; CEMT SET TRANSACTION(PNEW) DISABLED
capabilities.rollback: CEMT SET TRANSACTION(PNEW) ENABLED; channel back to 3270

capabilities.name: Underwriting decision
capabilities.new: underwriting decision, override and history APIs
capabilities.switch: channel calls the API; CEMT SET TRANSACTION(PUWR) DISABLED

capabilities.name: Renewal
capabilities.switch: channel calls the API; CEMT SET TRANSACTION(PRWL) DISABLED

capabilities.name: Endorsement
capabilities.switch: channel calls the API; CEMT SET TRANSACTION(PEND) DISABLED

capabilities.name: Events and Broker Portal access
capabilities.legacy: TD queue ACME writes, Broker Portal ODBC linked server
capabilities.new: Kafka domain events (outbox), Kafka-to-MQ bridge, GET /api/v1/policies
capabilities.switch: event-producing capabilities write the outbox; Broker Portal reads the API
capabilities.rollback: CICS path writes the TD queue again once C-4..C-7 are back on LEGACY

capabilities.name: System of record
capabilities.switch: PAS_BATCH_JOB=migrationSystemOfRecord system=PG confirm=YES; pas-persistence datasource to PostgreSQL

steps.action: Go/no-go 1: confirm every prerequisite (P1-P4) is closed and every criterion GN-01..GN-08 has evidence; publish the freeze notice to channels, Claims, Actuarial, Broker Portal, FileNet and underwriting work queue owners
Last parallel-run day clean (make migration-parallel-run on the captured outputs); latest migrationReconciliation MATCH; take DB2 image copies of ACMEINS and a PostgreSQL base backup
Start of freeze: disable CICS PNEW, PRWL, PEND, PUWR (PQRY stays enabled read-only); HOLD CA-7 PAS0050, PAS0100, PAS0200; set API write routes to 503 at the gateway
Run PAS_BATCH_JOB=migrationDeltaSync until a run applies zero changes, then PAS_BATCH_JOB=migrationReconciliation; any difference is NO-GO
Align the PostgreSQL policy-number sequence above the DB2 high-water mark plus the DB2 cache (data-migration.md, sequence step)

PAS_BATCH_JOB=migrationSystemOfRecord system=PG confirm=YES changedBy=<id> reason=<change ticket>; point pas-policy-service and pas-batch at PostgreSQL; enable migrationReverseSync for the rollback window
Route each capability in order C-11, C-3, C-10, C-4, C-5, C-6, C-7, C-1/C-2, C-8, C-9 using the switch in this plan; record each state change (LEGACY to NEW) in the change record

Run pas/scripts/cutover-smoke.sh against production with PAS_ALERTMANAGER_URL (SM-01, SM-02, SM-04, SM-07); record manual evidence for SM-03 (product owner) and SM-08 (event ids delivered through the bridge). SM-05/SM-06 run on the first scheduled batch runs in hypercare (CO-10), never inside the freeze
Go/no-go 2 (end of freeze): SM-01, SM-02, SM-03, SM-04, SM-07 and SM-08 passed and no open Sev1/Sev2: reopen writes; otherwise execute docs/pas/rollback-runbook.md before the window closes

14 days of hypercare: SM-05 and SM-06 on the first scheduled premium and extract runs (failure is a rollback trigger), daily reconciliation, daily review of alerts and incidents; record every Sev1/Sev2 in hypercare.incidents and the SM-05/SM-06 results in hypercare.checks; make cutover-hypercare decides exit (it stays open past day 14 until every check has passed)

smoke_tests.check: readiness UP, GET /api/v1/policies/{known policy} returns 200 with the expected premium (policy chosen at CO-02 and compared with DB2)
unauthenticated call returns 401 and a call without pas.policy.read returns 403
one test policy created, underwritten, endorsed and renewed through the API by a business user on a test agent/branch; policy then cancelled per the product owner's procedure
GET /api/v1/policies (Broker Portal list) returns 200 for a known agent
first scheduled premiumRecalculation run (during hypercare) completes, PREMRPT totals match the DB2 premium totals for the business date; a failure is a rollback trigger
first scheduled claimsDailyExtract (and actuarialMonthlyExposure when due) during hypercare delivered with receipts; Claims/Actuarial confirm import; a missed or rejected feed is a rollback trigger
Prometheus reachable with a token; Alertmanager reports no Pas* alert firing (PasReconciliationFailed, PasDeltaSyncFailing, bridge DLT); PAS_ALERTMANAGER_URL is mandatory outside the local stack

for each SM-03 event id: pasapp.event_outbox.published_at is set (read-only DBA query), the id is absent from GET /api/v1/ops/events/outbox/parked and the dead-letter list, and the bridge delivered its 125-byte POLICY-RECORD to the destination for its event type: policy lifecycle events to FileNet, underwriting events to the underwriting work queue; the flow must reach both destinations (event ids recorded in the change record)

go_no_go.criterion: Prerequisites P1-P4 closed (make cutover reports 0 open prerequisite items)
Final migrationReconciliation MATCH on all 7 tables after the last delta sync
Rollback rehearsed end to end on a production-sized copy within the agreed window (rollback-runbook.md RR-01..RR-09)
Automated smoke tests pass in pre-production with the production configuration
Dashboards, alerts and on-call rota live for pas-policy-service and pas-batch; support-runbook.md accepted by operations
Downstream owners (Claims, Actuarial, Broker Portal, FileNet, underwriting work queue) confirm readiness and the freeze window
Security approval of the production configuration (IdP clients, SFTP keys, secrets)
Product owner business acceptance and ARB approval of ADR 0001

triggers: a Sev1, or a Sev2 without a fix inside 4 hours, attributable to the new platform
reconciliation difference that is not explained within one business day
a downstream feed (Claims, Actuarial, FileNet, underwriting work queue) missed or rejected
a smoke test fails at CO-08 and cannot be fixed before the end of the freeze

hypercare.incident_source: the production incident tool, PAS service (FU-530-3)

checks.note: includes the first actuarialMonthlyExposure run; hypercare stays open past day 14 until it has run
